title: Mulberry Sells More Bags at Full Price

source.author: Shubhendu Vimal
source.title: Mulberry reports 18% H1 FY2027 sales growth

figures.text: article dated October 19, 2026 (RIN byline date; FashionUnited URL 20261019)
half year ended September 26, 2026 (FU: 26 weeks ended September 26, 2026); 26 weeks = precisely half of a 52-week year
figures.quote: In its trading update for the half year ended 26 September 2026,

figures.text: group sales up 18% (FU: 18.1% at actual currency rates)
figures.quote: reported an 18% increase in group sales during the first half (H1) of FY2027

figures.text: exact figure 18.1% at actual currency rates (FashionUnited)
figures.quote: announced an 18.1 percent increase in sales at actual currency rates for the 26 weeks ended September 26, 2026.

figures.text: US sales +28% YoY (FashionUnited only; RIN gives US 34% like-for-like, also in FU)
figures.quote: Revenue in the US grew 28 percent year-over-year (YoY), or 34 percent on a like-for-like (LFL) basis,

figures.text: US growth: digital, Bloomingdale's Marketplace launch, wider wholesale presence (both sources)
figures.quote: performance was supported by higher customer demand, digital sales growth, the launch of Bloomingdale's Marketplace, and a wider wholesale presence.

figures.text: Europe excluding UK +23% YoY (FashionUnited; RIN: 21% LFL, matches FU)
figures.quote: European sales, excluding the UK, increased 23 percent YoY (21 percent LFL).

figures.text: UK +10% YoY (FashionUnited; RIN: 9% LFL, matches FU)
figures.quote: In the UK, sales grew 10 percent YoY and 9 percent LFL.

figures.text: Asia Pacific total sales +5% YoY (FashionUnited; RIN: 24% LFL, matches FU)
figures.quote: Asia Pacific total sales rose 5 percent YoY, recorded at 24 percent LFL.

figures.text: franchise and wholesale +52%; 17% of revenue vs 16% a year earlier (both sources)
figures.quote: The franchise and wholesale division grew 52 percent YoY, representing 17 percent of total revenue for the period compared to 16 percent in the prior year period.

figures.text: Bayswater and Lily demand sustained; new launches incl. Stevie, Darley Camera Bag (both sources)
figures.quote: Demand was sustained across core product families including Bayswater and Lily, alongside new launches such as Raffia, Crochet, Stevie, and the Darley Camera Bag.

figures.text: CEO Andrea Baldo: past year spent refocusing on product, brand and customer
figures.quote: The strength of our performance reflects the work undertaken over the past year to refocus the Group around product, brand and customer,

figures.text: growth driven by full-price sales (FU headline)
figures.quote: Mulberry records 18 percent H1 revenue growth driven by full-price sales

figures.text: Baldo: full-price growth shows collections resonate in key markets despite challenging environment (FU, indirect)
figures.quote: growth in full-price sales demonstrates collection resonance across key markets despite a challenging trading environment.
Mulberry said it maintained a "disciplined" trading approach and restricted discounting during the period.

figures.text: promotional sales share 300 basis points (= 3 percentage points) lower excluding markdowns, supporting gross margin (both sources)
figures.quote: Excluding markdown activity, promotional sales represented a proportion of sales 300 basis points lower than in the previous-year period, supporting gross margin performance.

figures.text: medium-term targets: revenue above £200m, adjusted EBIT margin 15% (both sources)
figures.quote: continues to target annual revenue of more than £200m ($266.7m) and an adjusted EBIT margin of 15% over the medium term.
FY2026 group revenue of £125.5m, up 4% from £120.4m a year earlier.
The company is scheduled to publish its H1 results on 19 November 2026.
